Virat Kohli's team denies Rs 5 crore claim over Premanand Maharaj visit

Virat Kohli's team has denied claims that the cricketer was paid INR 5 crore to visit the ashram of Premanand Maharaj. A spokesperson for Kohli stated that the allegations are false. The Free Press Journal reported that Kohli's team referred to Dinesh Falahari in their response.
